query: What are the main kinds of issues these support tickets are about?

per_column.name: issue_category
per_column.rationale: Directly answers the query about the main kinds of issues; provides a clean, balanced grouping axis (bug, feature_request, outage, etc.). Sample values are well-grounded: SSO session drop -> bug, 502 for whole tenant -> outage, pin reports -> feature_request. The billing duplicate line item labelled data_integrity over billing is defensible.

per_column.name: issue_subtype
per_column.rationale: Adds a genuine finer-grained functional axis (auth_and_sso, data_export_import, ui_and_ux) that complements rather than restates issue_category. Samples map soundly to source text. CS-0003 subtype api_and_integration is a slightly weaker read (a 502 gateway on a dashboard), but still plausible.

per_column.name: affected_component
per_column.rationale: A useful system-oriented axis distinct from category/subtype. Most samples are well-grounded (billing_engine, authentication, dashboard_ui). The dominant 'other' bucket (105) reflects honest 'unknown' behaviour for silent rows and should not be penalised; CS-0005 CSV export -> 'other' is a reasonable non-commitment.

per_column.name: incident_scope
per_column.rationale: Blast-radius axis (single_user vs entire_tenant vs subset) is a genuinely new dimension for triage-style analysis. Grounded well: 'all members of the Acme tenant' -> entire_tenant, individual customer -> single_user. CS-0005 marked entire_tenant is a slight inference but account-level toggle request supports tenant scope.

per_column.name: operational_impact
per_column.rationale: Impact severity axis (blocked_workflow, financial_exposure, compliance_risk) offers real analytical leverage beyond category. Samples are warranted: duplicate invoice inflating total -> financial_exposure, 502 blocking presentation -> blocked_workflow. CS-0002 'blocked_workflow' for periodic session drops is somewhat generous but defensible.

judge.rationale: The added columns form a coherent, multi-axis decomposition (what kind, finer subtype, affected component, blast radius, operational impact) that directly serves the query about the main kinds of issues, with each column contributing a distinct non-redundant grouping dimension. Values across the row_evidence_samples are sound readings of the source text, with only minor generous inferences and no clear hallucinations; the large 'other' bucket reflects appropriate abstention rather than invention.
